day_local: Khamiista Toddobaadka 31-aad ee Wakhtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
homily:
Bal ka fikir sawirka nin da’ ah oo ku dhex socda beer weyn oo ay ku yaallaan geedo badan, laakiin uu si gaar ah u raadinayo hal geed oo uu jecel yahay. Waxaa laga yaabaa in geedkaas uu yahay mid uu gacantiisa ku beeray, mid uu daryeelay markii uu yaraa, oo uu hadda u xiisayo inuu arko. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa sawir la mid ah: adhijirka oo ka taga sagaashan iyo sagaal idaad si uu u raadiyo hal idaad oo luntay. Waa sawirka jacaylka aan xad lahayn ee Ilaah u qabo mid kasta oo inaga mid ah. 

Waxaan maanta ka fikireynaa Benjamin Vo. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil nolosha u arkaayay indho xiiso leh, wiil maskaxdiisu ay ku dhex noolayd dunida tiknoolajiyadda iyo riyada ah inuu abuuro 'con chim airlines'—shirkaddaas yare ee uu mar walba qosol iyo dhoola caddayn ku xasuusin jiray markii uu ka sheekaynayey. Laakiin in ka badan caqligiisa, waxaan xusuusannaa qalbigiisa. Waxaan xusuusannaa sawirka Ben oo si naxariis leh u garab taagan walaalkiis Ryan, ama markii uu si sharaf leh u xirnaa koofiyadda qalin-jabinta. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiilka mar walba diyaar u ahaa inuu qof kale ka hormariyo naftiisa, sida markii uu u soo bandhigay inuu u huro lacagtiisa sanduuqa ku jirta si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu diyaar u yahay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo waa calaamad muujinaysa jacayl aan xad lahayn oo uu ka dhaxlay Aabbihiis iyo Hooyadiis.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaan rabaa inaan si daacad ah idiinla hadlo. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad guriga dhexdiisa dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad naftiina ku eedaysaan, ama aad is weydiisataan haddii aad wax ka qaban karteen. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, waxaan rabaa inaan idin sheego runta: Ilaah wuu idin arkaa. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaad dareemi kartaa xorriyadda inaad baroorato adigoon dareemin dambi, waayo jacaylkaaga ayaa ahaa kan ugu weyn.

Bawlos, akhriska koowaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Wax kasta oo aan u haystay guul, waxaan u arkay khasaare Masiixa aawadiis.' Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil fahmay in jacaylka uu u qabo qoyskiisa iyo Ilaah uu ka qiimo badan yahay wax kasta oo dunidan ah. Wuxuu ahaa wiil si dhab ah u doondoonayay Ilaah, xataa markii uu ku dhex jiray xanuunka. Wuxuu ahaa wiilka ku yiri Aabbihiis riyadii uu ku arkay: 'Baaba, test nào con cũng qua hết.' Haa, Ben wuu gudbay, wuxuuna hadda joogaa meel uu nabad ku helo. 

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, xusuuso in Ben uu weli ku jiro wadnahaaga. Adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ha ka baqina inaad nolosha ku raaxaysataan, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdaan. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Sida gacantii uu Ben u fidiyay qoyskiisa, jacaylka uu kuu hayo wuxuu sii wadi doonaa inuu ku dhex koro nolol maalmeedkaaga, isagoo ku siinaya xoog iyo rajo. 

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in geedka noloshaada uu weli Ilaah daryeelayo, isagoo ku daraya jacayl maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kuu jecelahay wax walba, waxaana raba inaan naftayda kugu biiriyo. Maadaama aanan hadda si muuqata kuu qaadan karin, fadlan qalbigayga ka gal ruux ahaan. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo horey ii dhex jooga, waxaana gebi ahaanba naftayda kuu dhiibayaa. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go’o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa. Nabadda Rabbiga ha idinla jirto had iyo goor.
standing_petitions: Waxaan u baryeynaa Benjamin iyo dhammaan kuwii ka horreeyay ee dhintay, inay nabad iyo iftiin ku helaan gacmaha Masiixa.
Waxaan u baryeynaa dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, in Ilaah uu qalbigooda dejiyo oo uu siiyo rajo aan dhammaanayn.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal: Annagu waxaan nahay kuwa gudanaya gudniinka, annaga oo ku caabuda Ruuxa Ilaah, oo ku faana Ciise Masiix, oo aan isku halleynin jidhka, in kastoo aniguba aan haysto sabab aan jidhka isugu halleeyo. Haddii qof kale uu u maleeyo inuu jidhka isku halleyn karo, anigu aad ayaan uga sii halleyn karaa. Waxaa la i gude maalintii siddeedaad, waxaan ka mid ahay qowmiyadda Israa'iil, qabiilka Benyaamiin, waxaan ahay Cibraani ka dhashay Cibraaniyiin, xagga sharcigana waxaan ahaa Farisi, xagga dadaalkana waxaan ahaa kii kaniisadda silciya, xagga xaqnimada sharcigana waxaan ahaa mid aan eed lahayn. Laakiin wax kasta oo aan u haystay guul, waxaan u arkay khasaare Masiixa aawadiis. Waxaa intaas dheer, wax walba waxaan u arkaa khasaare sababtoo ah qiimaha weyn ee aan u hayo aqoonta Ciise Masiix oo ah Rabbigey.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: Ha rayraynayaan kuwa Rabbiga doondoona. U gabya isaga, u gabya ammaantiisa, oo ku dhawaaqa camalkiisa cajaa'ibka leh. Ku faana magiciisa quduuska ah; ha rayraynayaan qalbiyada doondoona Rabbiga! Rabbiga iyo xooggiisa eega; mar walba doondoona wejigiisa. Xusuusta camalkiisa cajaa'ibka leh ee uu sameeyay, calaamooyinkiisa, iyo xukummadiisa uu ku dhawaaqay. Idinka farcanka Ibraahim, addoommadiisa, carruurta Yacquub, kuwa uu doortay! Isaga, Rabbiga, waa Ilaaheenna; xukummadiisa waxay ka jiraan dunida oo dhan.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Canshuur-qaadayaashii iyo dembiilayaashii oo dhami waxay u soo dhowaanayeen inay Ciise maqlaan, laakiin Farisiyiintii iyo culimadii sharcigu waxay bilaabeen inay ka cawdaan, iyagoo leh, 'Ninkani wuxuu soo dhoweeyaa dembiilayaasha, wuuna la cunaa.' Sidaa darteed Ciise wuxuu u soo jeediyay masaalkan: 'Waa kuma nin idin ka mid ah oo leh boqol idaad, haddii uu mid ka mid ah lumiyo, aan ka tagayn sagaashan iyo sagaalkii cidla, oo aan raacayn kii luntay ilaa uu helo? Markuu helo, wuxuu saaraa garbahiisa isagoo faraxsan, markuu gurigiisa yimaadana, wuxuu u yeeraa saaxiibbadiis iyo deriskiisa, wuxuuna ku yidhaahdaa, 'La farxa, waayo waxaan helay iddaydii luntay.' Waxaan idinku leeyahay, si la mid ah, waxaa jannada ka jiri doona farxad ka weyn dembiile mid ka toobad keenay, marka loo eego sagaashan iyo sagaal qof oo xaq ah oo aan u baahnayn toobad keen. Mise waa tuma naag haysata toban lacagood, haddii ay mid lumiso, aan shidanayn laambad, oo aan guriga baadhayn, iyadoo si taxaddar leh u raadinaysa ilaa ay ka hesho? Markay hesho, waxay u yeedhaa saaxiibadeed iyo deriskeeda, waxayna ku tidhaahdaa, 'La farxa, waayo waxaan helay lacagtii aan lumiyay.' Sidaas oo kale, waxaan idinku leeyahay, waxaa jiri doona farxad malaa'igaha Ilaah dhexdiisa dembiile mid ka toobad keenay.'

day: Thursday of the Thirty-first Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
